# Test boundary clipping
env = PointEnv(length=2, goal_x=0, goal_y=0, goal_radius=1)
print(f"Environment boundaries: [-{env.length//2}, {env.length//2}]")
print(f"Goal at: {env.goal}, radius: {env.goal_radius}")

# Test positive x boundary
env.reset()
print(f"\nTesting positive x boundary:")
for step in range(3):
    reward = env.step(1)  # Move right
    print(f"Step {step+1}: position {env.position}, reward {reward}")

# Test reward calculation at origin (should be in goal)
env.reset()
reward = env.step(0)  # Stay at origin
print(f"\nAt origin: position {env.position}, reward {reward}")
